items.summary: Disposition: blocked, with counsel_required escalation for upstream data rights and any public, affiliate, advertising, or alert use. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not redistribution rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public use of listings, descriptions, prices, and derivatives. Compliance is technical-only (36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown), operations and security sweeps are unavailable, and accuracy, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, do not send rights outreach, do not enable affiliate or advertising use, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work or reversible changes that add no data collection or public exposure. Human counsel must review any proposed Woot data use, privacy/jurisdiction treatment, and future monetization.

The candidate plan is conditionally acceptable only for containment and evidence work. Reject new launch, monetization, telemetry, prototype, and duplicate implementation admissions while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. The existing canonical CTA work may proceed only after the CTO releases capacity and its stated disclosure, accessibility, validation, rollback, and measurement gates pass. No revenue, ROI, margin, or causal-lift claim is supported by the available aggregate revenue evidence.

Launch-readiness remains active, not closed. Four tasks remain open; none has sufficient evidence for closure. Progress is limited to recorded Woot documentation, partial repository data-flow files, privacy/cookie pages, and draft terms. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the repository/configuration data-flow and retention table, vendor/log inventory, deployed consent and GA4 configuration capture, and unresolved counsel questions to the existing checklist. Do not request duplicate telemetry, contact Woot, or change the private gate.
